verdicts.rationale: Commit 2ea16a2e6e replaced a bounded LRUCache (maxsize=10_000) with an unbounded dictionary _cache: dict[str, SkuRecord] in services/inventory/cache.py. Without eviction, every lookup stores new SKU entries indefinitely, directly causing the observed memory leak of ~70 MiB/hour and subsequent OOMKilled restarts on the inventory pods.
Commit 634efe3656 only modifies CI workflow options in .github/workflows/ci.yml. It has no effect on inventory service runtime behavior or memory consumption.
